You may not return `"pass"` if you have legal moves. # Constraints - You may use any standard Python imports, including numpy. - Your code is allowed 1 second of execution time on a modern 3GHz CPU. # Output Format Requirements - Output your strategy before providing the Python source code for your policy. - Output the Python source code for your policy surrounded by `...` tags. # Example Output The strategy for this policy is... ...
